title: WisdomNet: trustable machine learning toward error-free classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.15299v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Misclassification is a critical problem in many machine learning applications. Since even the classifier models with high accuracy (e.g., > 95%) still introduce some misclassification error, it may not be possible to rely on the output of a classifier. In this paper, we introduce trustable learning, which prompts the learning model to yield only the true output, thus avoiding misclassifications. Whenever the model cannot decide the output accurately, the learning model should indicate that there could be a misclassification error if it is forced to classify, and hence, it should reject to make a decision or defer it to a human expert. Therefore, we develop a methodology for trustable learning and apply it to artificial neural networks and show that it is possible to develop a classifier with 0% misclassification error. translated_title: WisdomNet：面向无错误分类的可信机器学习
translated_abstract: 误分类是许多机器学习应用中的一个关键问题。由于即使是高准确率（例如大于95%）的分类器模型仍然会引入一定的误分类错误，因此可能无法完全依赖分类器的输出。在本文中，我们提出了“可信学习”的概念，它促使学习模型只产生真实的输出，从而避免误分类。每当模型无法准确判定输出时，学习模型应表明如果被迫进行分类则可能出现误分类错误，因此它应拒绝做出决策，或将决策推迟给人类专家。为此，我们开发了一种可信学习的方法论，并将其应用于人工神经网络，证明了可以开发出误分类错误率为0%的分类器。我们提出了一种名为WisdomNet的新型神经网络架构，通过引入（原文在此处截断）……可以实现零预测错误。
tldr: 本文提出一种名为WisdomNet的新型可信学习神经网络架构，通过在无法准确判定时拒绝决策或交由人类专家处理，实现了误分类错误率为0%的分类器。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes WisdomNet, a novel trustable learning neural network architecture that achieves 0% misclassification error by rejecting or deferring decisions to human experts when the model cannot classify accurately.
